messages:
sasha: Quick Q — need to give a couple devs access to LLM request traces in prod to debug a latency regression. Must NOT expose raw prompt text or PII. What’s the minimal Console/IAM surface we should grant? Prefer JIT / ephemeral if possible.

maria: Short answer: don’t grant broad Logging Viewer. Two safer patterns: 1) export redacted traces to a separate BigQuery dataset and grant read there; 2) create a custom role that only allows listing/getting the redacted log entries and restricts it with a resource condition. Always prefer JIT for prod.

alex: +1 on JIT. For clarity, what permissions does the custom role look like?

maria: Something like: 
```yaml
title: RedactedLLMTraceViewer
permissions:
  - logging.logEntries.list
  - logging.logEntries.get
  - resourcemanager.projects.get
  - bigquery.jobs.create  # if they need to run ad-hoc export queries
```
Then bind it scoped to the prod project and add a condition to only match logs with label `llm-trace=redacted` or a destination bucket dataset resource.

maria: Example gcloud bind (ephemeral plan):
```bash
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding my-prod-project \
  --member='group:eng-debug@redwood.ai' \
  --role='projects/my-prod-project/roles/RedactedLLMTraceViewer' \
  --condition='expression=resource.labels.environment=="prod" && resource.labels.llm_trace=="redacted",title="prod-llm-redacted"'
```

sasha: Nice. Do we have an automated redaction step for traces? I thought the runtime kept a redacted copy exported to logs/bq already.

security-bot: Reminder: any exported traces containing redacted fields must have a documented redaction transform and a KMS policy for the key used for reversible masking. See runbook: https://go/runbooks/llm-traces-redaction (if reversible masking is used, restrict KMS decrypt to auditors only).

alex: I’ll request a 2-hour JIT for sasha + 2 devs while we triage. @jit-bot can you create the request?

jit-bot: JIT request created: https://go/jit/req/PRJ-4827 — approvers: maria, security. Estimated window: 2h.

maria: I can approve once there’s a PR for the custom role + short justification. Please include which fields are redacted (eg prompt_text -> prompt_text_redacted).

sasha: Will open PR for: custom role, terraform binding, and a 1-paragraph justification saying: "temporary access for latency investigation, read-only, redacted traces only." Pinging @maria for review.

alex: Approved on my side. :thumbsup:

maria: Ack, will review the PR this evening. If we need quick access before PR merges, I can temporarily approve the JIT but prefer PR first for audit trail.

sasha: Got it — filing PR now and will follow up in-thread when it’s up. Thanks all. :pray:
